parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1 FT: sin⁻¹(1.5/their R). M1: use a correct method with their α to obtain an unsimplified θ, e.g. 2(sin⁻¹(1.5/R) − α) or 2(π − sin⁻¹(1.5/R) − α). A1: one correct answer, e.g. −0.74, in the interval. A1: second correct answer, e.g. 2.60 (2.5986), 11.8 (= 4π − 0.74), or −9.97 (= 2.60 − 4π). A1: obtain the other two correct answers, e.g. −9.97 and 11.8, and no others in the interval; ignore answers outside. If 1.11° is used, withhold the first accuracy mark gained but allow later accuracy marks. Allow 2.60. Degrees are treated as a misread. [Total: 5]
